title: Situ Nan Wakes
summary: Outside the Land of the Forsaken Immortals, Wang Lin's main body stops Zi Xin and Gongsun Fan as they come out. Zi Xin admits she used the Reincarnation Fruit as bait to find her father, after escaping being sold to the Suzaku Country as a cultivation furnace. She gives him the Reincarnation Fruit he needs, and his main body becomes a true Ancient God. Three years later, five-year-old Zhou Ru, born mute, is taken from Apricot Village by a Tianxing Sect daoist; Wang Lin saves her from mistreatment and raises her in his valley, where she speaks for the first time. Five years on, Liao Fan of the Snow Region attacks to take back the feather fan, and Situ Nan wakes and drives him off with the cold fire of the Underworld Ascension Method. Then the Suzaku envoy comes to take Zeng Niu to the ten-year duel with Hongdie, and the Snow Region sect master Li Yuanfeng lays a trap for him.
events: Wang Lin's main body intercepts Zi Xin and Gongsun Fan
Zi Xin explains her past and gives up a Reincarnation Fruit
The main body completes Body Cleansing and becomes a true Ancient God
Wang Lin takes in five-year-old Zhou Ru after the Tianxing Sect mistreats her
Liao Fan of the Snow Region attacks; Situ Nan wakes and uses Underworld Ascension cold fire
Wang Lin leaves Zhou Ru, the pagoda and the Thunder Toad with Tie Yan
Li Yuanfeng plans to kill Zeng Niu after the duel with Hongdie
cultivation: Wang Lin's clone is mid Soul Formation; his main body becomes a true Ancient God. Liao Fan is late Soul Formation; Li Yuanfeng is early Soul Transformation.
